messages:
carol: Heads-up — we're planning to flip the default model for text.generate from redwood/base-1 to redwood/base-2 next month. Question: what compatibility guarantees do we need to document? Also: will Accept-Model header be respected by SDKs? cc @sam @ines

sam: timeline? need to sync with Dedicated capacity & fallbacks.

carol: Targeting 2026-04-15 canary, 2026-05-01 full. Flexible.

ines: SDKs already support Accept-Model via 'accept_model' param in python and header in http. But client defaulting behavior needs doc update. Quick snippet:
```
curl -H 'Accept-Model: model=redwood/base-2;version=2026-04' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

jess: I'll update docs and examples.

maria: Note: embedding endpoints use model_pin — not auto-swapped. We should avoid surprising customers with pinned models.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline note: we'll enable rollout gating if error rate > 1% in canary.

sam: What about response schema changes? We should avoid renames of top-level fields (tokens, finish_reason). Propose: keep strict response shape for 90 days; new fields under 'meta' namespace only.

ines: Also propose server include 'x-model-version' response header. Example: `x-model-version: redwood/base-2@2026-04-15`

carol: Short list for docs: 1) default swap for unpinned customers only 2) Accept-Model header overrides 3) pinned customers unaffected 4) response header x-model-version 5) 8-week deprecation window before removing old default alias

sam: 8 weeks ok. Need outreach to top 50 orgs; I'll ping AM.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-04-15 08:00 UTC, rollout window 2h, monitored.

ines: Also add automatic fallback to base-1 for 30s if generation latency spikes > 500ms at 90th pct.

carol: Can we add compatibility tests? e2e harness that runs our existing prompt suite against both models and diffs embeddings/safety classifiers.

maria: I have a quick PR to set model_alias metadata. @jess can you include sample curl and SDK examples in the migration guide?

jess: Yep, will include. ETA tomorrow.

sam: Code review ping: @ines can you review runtime changes (#PR1234) — kernel selection + header passthrough. Mirror tests to eng/release board.

ines: On it, will review today. :eyes:

carol: Thanks. Can everyone add migration/compat checklist items to the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/model-default-flip (add access if needed).

dev-bot: Added checklist entry: 'accept-model header docs' assigned to jess.
